name: ReNN ~Another Story of Works Doll~
source:
Five years have passed since puppeteer Senjo formed the complete body of "sub-doll". The dolls  evolve each year, but the price tag remains sky high. 
Main character works at a plant and can't believe his luck to have found a sub-doll Renn...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
自人偶师千城完成‘亚人偶’的完整躯体以来，已经过去五年。人偶每年都在进化，售价却始终高得惊人。
主人公在一家工厂工作，偶然发现亚人偶莲恩，简直不敢相信自己会如此幸运…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
